fact.title: Monthly wages are due by the 7th of the next month
fact.claim: Monthly wages must be paid before the end of the 7th day of the next month.
fact.source: Code on Wages 2019 (text on labour.gov.in, seen through search results; page not opened)
fact.caveat: Reports say the Code has applied since 21 Nov 2025. The gazette notice was not read.

script.cover_1: Last month's salary has still not arrived.
script.payoff: Reports say monthly wages are due before the end of the 7th day.
script.caption: A late salary is a payment problem, not a favour you ask for. Send this to the friend who waits for the credit message.
script.situation: Can your company keep paying the salary weeks late?
script.answer: Reports say monthly wages are due before the end of the 7th day of the next month.
script.reply_me: My salary for last month has not come. Can you confirm the payment date? It is due by the 7th.
